line_times: Good afternoon, and welcome to What Would You Do? Here's today's situation. You buy groceries, and the cashier gives you ten dollars too much change. You see it in the parking lot. What would you do?
Our first caller is Grace. Hi, Grace!
Hi, Mike. If that happened to me, I'd go back inside and give the money back.
Really? Why would you go back?
Because the cashier made a mistake. If I kept the money, she would have a problem at the end of her shift.
That is a very honest answer. Thanks, Grace. Our next caller is Teresa. Teresa, what would you do?
Well, Mike, this really happened to me once. A cashier gave me twenty dollars too much.
I gave it back the next day. I was in a hurry, so I couldn't go back that day.
Yes, she was very happy. She said thank you three times!
And what would you do if it were only one dollar?
Hmm. If it were one dollar, I'd probably keep it. But I'd feel a little bad.
Ha! That's an honest answer, too. Thank you, Teresa.
Next week's question is this: what would you do if you found an envelope with money at work? I want to hear your ideas. And if you're going to call, call early!
